tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring, OCC APIs | 5+ yrs E-Commerce
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, and end-to-end integration with PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, performance tuning and techno-functional analysis within agile teams. I also contribute to code reviews, production support and AI-assisted development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited about adesso’s commitment to delivering cutting-edge SAP Commerce solutions for leading enterprises. With more than five years of hands-on experience building and extending SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I can immediately contribute to your projects.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented backend and frontend features on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211), covering product, catalog and pricing management following best-practice patterns.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: I developed and exposed OCC REST web services for headless storefronts and third-party consumers, and customized interceptors, populators and converters to enable seamless data flows.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: I built end-to-end PIM-to-Hybris pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, and resolved integration bottlenecks with SAP ERP and MDM systems across international teams.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: I gathered business requirements, wrote user stories and functional specifications, and guided junior developers while supporting production issues in an agile environment.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can add value to adesso.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_de.hook: Die digitale Transformationsstrategie von adesso begeistert mich, insbesondere die Umsetzung von SAP-Commerce-Projekten für globale Kunden. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Erweiterung von SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich das nötige Fachwissen mit.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Expertise
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich Backend- und Frontend-Funktionen auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) entwickelt, einschließlich Produkt-, Katalog- und Preisverwaltung nach Best-Practice-Muster.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Ich habe OCC-REST-Web-Services für Headless-Storefronts und Drittanbieter bereitgestellt und Interceptor, Populator und Converter angepasst, um reibungslose Datenflüsse zu gewährleisten.

bullets.label: Integration & Datenpipelines
bullets.text: Ich habe End-to-End-PIM-zu-Hybris-Pipelines mit Profisee, DataHub und Hotfolders aufgebaut und Integrationsengpässe zwischen SAP ERP und MDM-Systemen gemeinsam mit internationalen Teams gelöst.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Leitung
bullets.text: Ich habe Geschäftsanforderungen erfasst, User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen erstellt, Junior-Entwickler angeleitet und Produktionsprobleme im agilen Umfeld unterstützt.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zu adesso zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: adesso stands out as a technology-driven consultancy that combines deep SAP expertise with a strong focus on innovative, customer-centric solutions. I am attracted by your portfolio of large-scale SAP Commerce projects, the collaborative culture across German locations, and the opportunity to work on cutting-edge e-commerce transformations that leverage AI and cloud technologies – exactly where my experience adds the most value.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join adesso to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise in a forward-looking team that delivers innovative e-commerce solutions for leading brands.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m interested in the SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer role at adesso and would love to discuss how I can contribute.
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer position. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can add immediate value to adesso. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my application.
